Let those who observe the Sabbath and call it a delight, the people who sanctify the seventh day, rejoice in Thy kingdom. Let them all be satisfied and find delight out of Thine abundance. Thou hast favoured the seventh day and sanctified it, the most precious of days hast Thou called it, a reminder of the work of creation. Their meal-offering and their drink offering shall be as has been said, three tenths for the bullock, two tenths for the ram and one tenth for each lamb, wine according to its drink-offering and two he-goats in order to atone and the two regular offerings according to their rule. Besides the whole-offering of the new moon and its meal-offering and the regular whole-offering and its meal-offering and the drink offerings according to their rule for a sweet savour, a fire offering to the Lord.
